title: Exclude common-main coordinate coframes for query-thinned callers through C=.01
body:
The common-coframe decoder in Dugongue's PR5687 needs a new recursive invoice. This package proves that every coordinate common-main coframe assignment to the retained full nine-axis centre-free word has paid rank mass minus helper rank mass at least **2464**. It also permits paid replacement warps. Eight exact integral flow/cut certificates prove the minimum, and one assignment attains it while leaving every native warp ordinary.

The complete consequence is negative: **every p >= 1 and every prefix split in the standard query-thinned caller loses for supplier saving 0 <= C <= .01**. Its target-minus-paid moment is at most `-(53126/125)(p+2)-112`. At p16 the rank surplus is at most -10192. **No new kappa, complete supplier or selected-frontier change is claimed.** Different native words, non-coordinate Clifford coframes and different callers remain outside the theorem.

The verifier rebuilds both complete source graphs and all 408 helper endpoint debits. It checks capacities, conservation and flow=cut directly, without running the discovery optimizer. The attaining invoice is `796 H1+348 H8+281 H9` paid and `405 H9+3 ordinary identity outputs` returned. No original helper is erased or double-counted. The all-p proof grants the ordinary decoder and all extra ordinary work for free, so the rejection does not rely on a new machine implementation.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/common-coframe-coordinate-cut
```

Registered normal and optimized checks pass, including six corrupted-certificate controls. The exact 16-file committed-byte check, official export integrity check, Git-free optimized replay with empty PATH, and an actual damaged-source rejection pass. Scientific replay commit: `c4cfb6aac99933fb6dd5454f4ad18b89bc9aa377`; final documentation records that evidence. No full native/phase, precision, stock, tape, ordinary/outer admission, proof assistant or independent human review was run. Full-history ancestry is unavailable in the shallow checkout. Hosted CI is separate.

Base and canonical refresh: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`, priority revision 7. [Scoped coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19189922) separates this full nine-axis source from PR5698's restricted eight-plane optimum and active native/helper searches. Only `research/common-coframe-coordinate-cut` is added.

Credit Dugongue PR5687 for the ordinary decoder; Cinna Davis, Dugongue and the retained centre-free source; Cao Yifan's native word; DaysSky, Nick Petalas, Ryanson Jonathan, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and all source notices. Discovery reused Ali Romman's PR5698 flow routine; the new verifier checks its certificates independently of that optimizer. PR5693 supplies a parallel general cut direction. Flow/cut duality and concavity are classical. New source specialization, witnesses and caller bound: Ali Romman, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and no subagents. Apache-2.0.
